name: AK Aire LLC
what_they_do: Multi-trade home-services contractor (HVAC, plumbing, electrical and standby generators) founded in 2007 and based on Livingston Ave, serving all of New Jersey with 24/7 emergency service, free in-home estimates, maintenance subscriptions and financing.
customers: Homeowners and small businesses across Middlesex County and statewide NJ, including generator owners needing service and warranty work

size_signals.signal: 'Founded in 2007 ... family-owned and operated company staffed with fully trained, dedicated and licensed technicians'
Five service divisions (heating, cooling, plumbing, electrical, generators) plus an employment-opportunities page - more than a two-truck shop

listing.reviews: count not shown in limited Maps view

website_review.primary_cta: 'CALL TODAY! (732)-416-7719' button plus a 'GET $25 OFF WHEN YOU SCHEDULE ONLINE' lead form and 'CONTACT US NOW' hero button
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Gravity Forms lead form (name, email, phone, service checkboxes, message) behind an invisible reCAPTCHA; 'SCHEDULE AN ESTIMATE' just links to /contact-us/ - no calendar, no booking platform
website_review.trust_signals: Reviews page with long customer testimonials, gallery page, service-area page, financing page, licensed-technicians claim, since-2007 claim
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Dated visual identity (word-art logo, green tagline, clip-art graphics, carousel text baked into images) and a 2025 copyright year on a 2026 visit
website_review.search_basics: Title 'Heating & Air Conditioning Services in North Brunswick - AK Aire' with a matching description; deep per-service URLs (/cooling/ac-service-repairs/, /heating/heat-pumps/, /expertplumbing/, /electrical/, /air-quality/...)
top_issues: The home page initially rendered completely blank in Chrome and only painted after several seconds - slow, fragile front end
reCAPTCHA sits on the lead form, so an agent (or a customer with scripts blocked) cannot submit it
Copyright says 2025; hours are not printed anywhere on the site despite 24/7 claims

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: claimed Google profile with HVAC category, hours (closed/opens 8 AM), correct phone and a women-owned attribute, but it shows 'Add photos' prompts so imagery is thin; robots.txt only blocks /wp-admin/, so OAI-SearchBot/PerplexityBot/Googlebot are allowed. Answerable: services and service areas are real text, but no hours and no price ranges on the site; JSON-LD is a WebSite/WebPage/Organization graph without LocalBusiness address, opening hours or priceRange - so it does not answer 'when are you open / where do you serve'. Bookable: labelled form fields exist, but an invisible reCAPTCHA guards submission and 'schedule online' is only a form - no real appointment booking.

operations_signals.signal: Reviews describe calling and waiting for a callback ('said someone would call me back within the hour'), i.e. dispatch is manual phone-and-callback
Offers a 'Service Plus' subscription but tracks it in the intake form as a yes/no question - suggests plan administration is manual
Runs five distinct trade lines plus generators, so intake must route each job to the right technician type - a natural automation target

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the reCAPTCHA lead form with real online scheduling split by trade (HVAC / plumbing / electrical / generators) and automatic confirmation texts
top_opportunities.evidence: 'Schedule an estimate' only opens a captcha-protected contact form; no time slots anywhere on the site

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix site performance and refresh the dated front end so the home page paints instantly and looks current
top_opportunities.evidence: Home page rendered blank for several seconds in Chrome before painting; word-art logo, clip-art images, 2025 copyright

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add LocalBusiness schema plus hours and price ranges as text so assistants can answer 'open now?' and 'how much'
top_opportunities.evidence: Only WebSite/WebPage/Organization JSON-LD; no hours or prices on the page

scores.reasons: Five-trade contractor with subscription plans and statewide reach has real budget; gaps (captcha-blocked intake, no booking, no LocalBusiness schema, dated site) are substantial; the booking build is medium effort; everything observed first-hand.
